# Load libraries
```{r loading libraries}
# Load packages:
cat("load libraries\n")
library(tidyverse)      # data managing
library(tidyr)          
library(broom.mixed)    
library(dplyr) 
library(openxlsx)       # export to excel

library(ggplot2)        # plotting 
library(wesanderson)
library(ggpubr)
library(effects)        # effects for plotting
library(interactions)
library(emmeans)
library(sjPlot)         # model tables
library(sjmisc)
library(sjlabelled)


library(brms)           # bayesian models
library(performance)    # check model assumptions
library(rstan)
```

# Upasana's settings
```{r}
# Set directories
if(.Platform$OS.type == "unix"){dirs = '/project/2424182.03/'} else {dirs = 'P://2424182.03/'}
data_dir <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Dataframes")
out_dir <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Output_other")
out_dir_plots <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Plots")
out_dir_models <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Models")
out_dir_excel <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Excel")

# Penalize scientific notation

# Setup rstan params
```

# pGo data
```{r}
# load data
pgo_rds_full <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_pGo_group_control_action_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
pgo_rds_full <- add_criterion(pgo_rds_full, "loo", cores = 1)
pgo_rds_full <- add_criterion(pgo_rds_full, "waic", cores = 1)
pgo_rds_semi <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_1_pGo_group_control_action_valence_robotRep_semiRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
pgo_rds_semi <- add_criterion(pgo_rds_semi, "loo", cores = 1)
pgo_rds_semi <- add_criterion(pgo_rds_semi, "waic", cores = 1)
pgo_rds_norep <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_2_pGo_group_control_action_valence_norep_full_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
pgo_rds_norep <- add_criterion(pgo_rds_norep, "loo", cores = 1)
pgo_rds_norep <- add_criterion(pgo_rds_norep, "waic", cores = 1)

loo_compare(pgo_rds_full, pgo_rds_semi, pgo_rds_norep, criterion = "loo")
loo_compare(pgo_rds_full, pgo_rds_semi, pgo_rds_norep, criterion = "waic")

Acc_rds_full <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_Update_7_Acc_group_control_action_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
Acc_rds_full <- add_criterion(Acc_rds_full, "loo", cores = 1)
Acc_rds_full <- add_criterion(Acc_rds_full, "waic", cores = 1)
Acc_rds_semi <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_8_Acc_group_control_action_valence_robotRep_semiRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
Acc_rds_semi <- add_criterion(Acc_rds_semi, "loo", cores = 1)
Acc_rds_semi <- add_criterion(Acc_rds_semi, "waic", cores = 1)
Acc_rds_norep <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_9_Acc_group_control_action_valence_norepep_full_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
Acc_rds_norep <- add_criterion(Acc_rds_norep, "loo", cores = 1)
Acc_rds_norep <- add_criterion(Acc_rds_norep, "waic", cores = 1)

loo_compare(Acc_rds_full, Acc_rds_semi, Acc_rds_norep, criterion = "loo")
loo_compare(Acc_rds_full, Acc_rds_semi, Acc_rds_norep, criterion = "waic")

RT_rds_full <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_RT_group_control_action_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_gaussian.rds"))
RT_rds_full <- add_criterion(RT_rds_full, "loo", cores = 1)
RT_rds_full <- add_criterion(RT_rds_full, "waic", cores = 1)
RT_rds_semi <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_14_RT_group_control_action_valence_robotRep_semiRandom_BRMS_gaussian.rds"))
RT_rds_semi <- add_criterion(RT_rds_semi, "loo", cores = 1)
RT_rds_semi <- add_criterion(RT_rds_semi, "waic", cores = 1)
RT_rds_norep <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_15_RT_group_control_action_valence_norep_full_BRMS_gaussian.rds"))
```

# WSLS
```{r}
wsls_rds_full <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_12_WSLS_group_control_prevOutcome_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_full <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_full, "loo", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_full <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_full, "waic", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_semi <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_18_WSLS_group_block_prevoutcome_robotRep_semirandom_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_semi <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_semi, "loo", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_semi <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_semi, "waic", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_norep <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_20_WSLS_group_block_prevoutcome_noRep_full_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_norep <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_norep, "loo", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_norep <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_norep, "waic", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_action <-read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_19_prevAction_WSLS_group_block_control_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_action <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_action, "loo", cores = 1)
wsls_rds_action <- add_criterion(wsls_rds_action, "waic", cores = 1)

loo_compare(wsls_rds_full, wsls_rds_semi, wsls_rds_norep, wsls_rds_action, criterion = "loo")
loo_compare(wsls_rds_full, wsls_rds_semi, wsls_rds_norep, wsls_rds_action, criterion = "waic")
```

# Emmeans 
```{r}
pgo_rds_go <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_3_Go_pGo_group_control_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
pgo_rds_nogo <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_4_NoGo_pGo_group_control_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
pgo_rds_hc <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_5_HC_pGo_group_control_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
pgo_rds_lc <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_6_LC_pGo_group_control_valence_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
```


```{r}
# emmeans for three way interaction control * action * rep
emtrends_go <- emtrends(pgo_rds_go, "controllability_brms", var = "robot_repetition_z", type = "response")
cat("Trends for the slope of go-responses over reps by controllability for go-action robots\n\n")
emtrends_go
cat("\nPairwise comparisons for pgo over reps high control - low-control for go-robots\n\n")
pairs(emtrends_go)
emtrends_nogo <- emtrends(pgo_rds_nogo, "controllability_brms", var = "robot_repetition_z", type = "response")
cat("\nTrends for the slope of go-responses over reps by controllability for no go-action robots\n\n")
emtrends_nogo
cat("Pairwise comparisons for pgo over reps high control - low-control for no go-robots\n\n")
pairs(emtrends_nogo)

emmeans_go <- emmeans(pgo_rds_go, "controllability_brms", type = "response")
cat("\npGo for high and low control for go-robots\n\n")
emmeans_go
cat("\nPairwise comparisons for pgo for high control - low-control for go-robots\n\n")
pairs(emmeans_go)

emmeans_nogo <- emmeans(pgo_rds_nogo, "controllability_brms", type = "response")
cat("\npGo for high and low control for no go-robots\n\n")
emmeans_nogo
cat("\nPairwise comparisons for pgo for high control - low-control for no go-robots\n\n")
pairs(emmeans_nogo)


emtrend_go_rep <- emtrends(pgo_rds_go, ~ 1, var = "robot_repetition_z", type = "response")
emtrend_go_rep

emtrend_nogo_rep <- emtrends(pgo_rds_nogo, ~ 1, var = "robot_repetition_z", type = "response")
emtrend_nogo_rep

```

# Win stay lose switch
```{r}
wsls_rds_full <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_19_prevAction_WSLS_group_block_control_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_pos <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_19_pos_WSLS_group_control_prevAction_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_neg <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_20_neg_WSLS_group_control_prevAction_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_A <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_21_A_WSLS_control_prevOutcome_prevAction_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_B <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_22_B_WSLS_control_prevOutcome_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_hc <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_16_HC_WSLS_group_prevOutcome_prevAction_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))
wsls_rds_lc <- read_rds(file.path(out_dir_stats, "BRMS_17_LC_WSLS_group_prevOutcome_prevAction_robotRep_fullRandom_BRMS_bernoulli.rds"))


```


```{r}
library(forcats)
ce_wsls <- conditional_effects(
  wsls_rds_action,
  effects = "controllability_brms:prev_outcome",
  conditions = data.frame(group = c("1", "-1")),
)
ce_df <- ce_wsls[[1]]
ce_df$block <- recode_factor(ce_df$controllability_brms, "1" = "C+/V-", "-1" = "C-/V+")
ce_df$group <- recode_factor(ce_df$group, "1" = "Placebo", "-1" = "Escitalopram")
fct_relevel(ce_df$group, "Escitalopram", "Placebo")
ce_df$prev_outcome <- recode_factor(ce_df$prev_outcome, "1" = "Positive", "-1" = "Negative")
ce_df$block <- fct_relevel(ce_df$block, "C+V-", "C-V+")
ce_wsls_plot <- ggplot(ce_df, aes(x = block,
                  y = estimate__,
                  group = prev_outcome,
                  color = prev_outcome)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.50)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wes_palette("GrandBudapest1", n = 2), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values= wes_palette("GrandBudapest1", n = 2)) +
  ylab("Probability of repeating response p(Stay)") + xlab("Block type") +
  ggtitle("Predicted p(Stay) a response by group, block type and previous outcome") +
  labs(color = "Previous outcome") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title_axis, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title = element_text(size = size_title_axis),
    legend.text = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) 
ce_wsls_plot  
ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_plots, "ModelPred_WSLS_group_control_outcome.pdf"), ce_wsls_plot, width=15, height=10, dpi = "retina")
```

```{r}
library(colorspace)
ce_wsls_2 <- conditional_effects(
  wsls_rds_action,
  effects = "robot_repetition_z:prev_outcome",
  conditions = data.frame(
    group = c("1", "-1")  # replace with your actual levels
  )
)
ce_df <- ce_wsls_2[[1]]
ce_df$group <- recode_factor(ce_df$group, "1" = "Placebo", "-1" = "Escitalopram")
ce_df$group <- fct_relevel(ce_df$group, "Escitalopram", "Placebo")
ce_df$prev_outcome <- recode_factor(ce_df$prev_outcome, "1" = "Positive", "-1" = "Negative")
ce_df$prev_outcome <- fct_relevel(ce_df$prev_outcome, "Positive", "Negative")

ce_plot2 <- ggplot(ce_df, aes(x = robot_repetition_z,
                  y = estimate__,
                  color = group)) +
  # facet_grid(cols = vars(group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.5, linetype="dashed", color = "grey", alpha = 0.85, linewidth=1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__,
                fill = group,
                group = interaction(group, prev_outcome)),
            alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
geom_line(aes(linetype = prev_outcome,
              group = interaction(group, prev_outcome)),
          linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wes_palette("Royal2", n = 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values= darken(wes_palette("Royal2", n = 2), amount = 0.5), guide = "none")+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "twodash")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = round(seq(2, 10, by = 1),1)) +
  ylab("Probability of repeating a response (p(Stay))") +
  ggtitle("Predicted p(Stay) over repetitions by group and previous outcome") +
  labs(fill = "Group", linetype = "Previous outcome") + xlab("Robot repetition")+
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title_axis, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title_axis, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title = element_text(size = size_title_axis),
    legend.text = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
ce_plot2
ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_plots, "ce_plot_WSLS_group_prevOutcome_rep.pdf"), ce_plot2, width=15, height=10, dpi = "retina")
```

# Action bias?
```{r}
conditional_effects(wsls_rds_action, effects = "prev_action:group")
emmeans(wsls_rds_action, pairwise ~ prev_action * group)
emm <- emmeans(wsls_rds_action, ~ prev_action | group, type = "response")
contrast(emm, method = "pairwise")

ce_wsls <- conditional_effects(
  wsls_rds_action,
  effects = "group:prev_action",
  conditions = data.frame(group = c("1", "-1")),
)
ce_df <- ce_wsls[[1]]
ce_df$group <- recode_factor(ce_df$group, "1" = "Placebo", "-1" = "Escitalopram")
ce_df$group <- fct_relevel(ce_df$group, "Escitalopram", "Placebo")
ce_df$prev_action <- recode_factor(ce_df$prev_action, "1" = "Go", "-1" = "No go")
ce_df$prev_action <- fct_relevel(ce_df$prev_action, "Go", "No go")
ce_wsls_plot <- ggplot(ce_df, aes(x = prev_action,
                  y = estimate__,
                  group = group,
                  color = group)) +
  #facet_grid(cols = vars(group)) +
  geom_point(size = 6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  #scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.50)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wes_palette("Royal2", n = 2), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values= wes_palette("Royal2", n = 2)) +
  ylab("Probability of repeating response p(Stay)") + xlab("Previous action") +
  ggtitle("Predicted p(Stay) by previous action per group") +
  labs(color = "Group") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = color_text, size = size_title_axis, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title = element_text(size = size_title_axis),
    legend.text = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) 
ce_wsls_plot  
ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir_plots, "modelPred_wsls_group_prevAction.pdf"), ce_wsls_plot, width=15, height=10, dpi = "retina")
```
